text.tspan: returns pixel on the next clock,

div.p: MEM_FILE loading Each sprite_rom instance has an initial block that calls $readmemh(MEM_FILE). Files are 4096 lines of hex bytes, relative to the Quartus working dir. The palette index 0xFF (= COL_TRANSPARENT in entity_drawer.sv:89) marks transparent pixels — the drawer skips those layers.

initial $readmemh(MEM_FILE, rom) (sprite_rom.sv:21-23) Loaded at elaboration. Each line of the .mem file is one hex byte (palette index 0x00..0x0C; 0xFF means transparent). First lines of peashooter_idx.mem are FF (top-of-sprite transparent region).
